nodes.name: POST /api/v1/auth/sign-out
nodes.purpose: Sign out: end THIS session on the server, not only in the browser. Before 2026-10-11 sign-out deleted the browser's copy and nothing else, so a copied token kept working for up to 24 hours. Tokens minted before session ids existed cannot be singled out; they are reported as such and end at expiry (or with a password change).

nodes.name: POST /api/v1/auth/sign-out-others
nodes.purpose: Sign out of every other device, without changing the password: for a phone left behind or a shared computer someone forgot to sign out of. Same mechanism as a password change (sessions_valid_after, migration 00045): every token issued so far is refused and this device gets a fresh one minted at the cut-off. Allowed for suspended accounts, like a password change: securing an account is not something to withhold.

nodes.name: Only `ROLE_USER` may submit applications; recruiters may not apply
Candidates review own applications only; recruiters all for their companies
Only recruiters/admins create scorecards and notes
User edits own profile only; admin any
Flags, audit, settings, user mgmt, moderation are admin-only
Billing actions available to recruiters, not users/admins
Route-level RBAC matches shared route registry
Saved-search digest runs as service-owned/audited scheduler
No duplicate ACTIVE application per user per job (partial UNIQUE + 90-day cooldown post-terminal)
Application drafts autosave 30s; recoverable; versions retained
Challenge language allowlist; execution limits per TD-05
XP idempotent UNIQUE(user_id, reference_type, reference_id); daily cap **200 XP/day**
Analytics metadata whitelist-only; no raw text/tokens/secrets
Extension data stays in chrome.storage.local; no sync/fetch/network
Schedulers dry-run default; idempotent delivery keys
AI drafts never auto-commit to records
Jobs require approved org + verified owner
Candidates may apply only to open jobs
Recruiters access only their org's applications
Offers require completed HM-scoped scorecard review
Resumes are scanned for viruses before text extraction
Extracted resume text encrypted at rest
Rejection emails sent with configurable delay (default 24h)
Course enrollments unique per (user, course) for active status
Course completion requires passing final assessment (≥70%)
Challenge submissions run in isolated sandbox
Sandbox execution has hard resource limits (30s CPU, 512MB RAM, 1GB disk)
Challenge test cases split: public + hidden
Badges minted only upon verified milestone completion
Referral rewards pay out after referred candidate's first verified hire
Subscription changes apply at period boundary (or prorated)
Entitlements derive from active subscription only
Jobs auto-close after expiry (configurable, default 60 days)
Applications auto-archive after 90 days in submitted
Moderation flags expire after 7 days if not actioned
XP transactions unique per (user, reference_type, reference_id)
Profile completeness ≥70% gate for job applications
Verified organizations receive accelerated job approval
Candidates may request data export; delivered within 30 days
Recruiters see verified signals on candidate profiles
AI outputs below 0.7 confidence display disclaimer
AI outputs below 0.5 confidence are suppressed
Account termination requires Platform Admin dual approval
Interviewer inactivity auto-escalation: 7 business days → HM escalation; 14 days → auto-transition stale_withdrawn
Candidate non-response auto-release: 5 business days → reminders; 8 days → candidate_unresponsive
Abandoned requisition protection: >21 calendar days → review; 30 days → auto-pause + billing credit
Managed learners access course only while org holds unexpired assigned seat
Seat revocation triggers 7-day grace; in-progress assessments never interrupted
Seat consumption atomic; last-seat concurrency never oversells
Revoked seat returns to pool; learner progress and certificates retained
Graduation transition retains all verified signals and severs FERPA-restricted records
Bulk imports require dry-run validation preview; no silent partial imports
Faculty/Proctor hold no org-level billing, licensing, or user-management privileges
Employer-facing student showcases require recorded, revocable consent
Every org-owned record scoped by `organization_id`; cross-tenant reads prohibited
Institutional pricing tiers configurable per course/package; never hard-coded
Course-access authorization server-side: org + learner + license + enrollment + validity
External media validated before publication; invalid/private/embed-blocked rejected
Provider embedding restrictions never bypassed; protected content never downloaded
Provider capabilities determine available playback/completion settings
Broken external provider isolated to affected content item; course remains functional
Platform stores learner progress even for externally hosted playback where trackable
Unsupported providers produce explicit errors, never silent broken embeds
Authors attest right to use external content before publication
Course submission requires ≥5 lessons and ≥30 min total content
Course requires ≥1 video or text lesson (no quiz-only courses)
Structural edits to a published course require a new version
Rating requires ≥20% course progress and verified enrolment
Instructor must have an approved profile before publishing
Coupon cannot reduce price below platform minimum
Refund window 30 days from purchase (configurable), pro-rated after
Instructor earnings = 70% of net revenue after platform commission (configurable)
Peer review requires ≥2 completed reviews per submission
Instructor cannot review or rate own course
Course version preserves existing student progress
Learning-path courses complete in declared order when sequenced
Quiz attempts bounded by configured max; practice quizzes unlimited
Graded quiz contributes to course grade; passing score configurable
Final exam cumulative; required for course completion when configured
Program certificate issued only when all required path courses complete
Assignment late submission flagged, graded per instructor policy
Auto-grading for code assignments reuses the challenge sandbox
Question-bank reuse preserves per-attempt snapshots (no retroactive edits)
Course archive/unpublish preserves enrolled-student access per policy
All course purchases are idempotent and webhook-owned
One reaction per user per target; changeable, never additive
One repost per user per post
Post edits retain an "edited" marker and version history
Comment authors and post authors may moderate; authors may disable comments
Mentions notify only if the recipient allows mentions
Follows unique; blocked/muted targets cannot be followed
Newsletter subscriptions opt-in only; one-click unsubscribe (RFC 8058)
Feed must always offer a chronological view; ranking factors disclosed on demand
UGC passes pre-publish abuse scan; post rate limits per actor
Sponsored content labelled as sponsored; never undisclosed in organic ranking
Mute hides content without unfollowing and without notifying the muted party
Minors (16+) get private-by-default profiles and restricted outreach
Outreach credit consumed on send to a non-connection; refunded on reply within 7 days
Written recommendations display only after recipient acceptance
Profile-view logging honours the viewer's privacy mode
Identity-verification badges only via approved partners; failure never blocks core use
Salary aggregates displayed only with ≥5 reports for a role/location cell
Anonymous reviews hide identity from employer and public, never from Platform Admin/legal
Company responses are appended, never edit the original review
Interview questions require moderation before public display
Contest submissions locked at server-authoritative end time; clock skew never extends
Certification exam pass requires the configured score in a single attempt (retake policy configurable)
Skills taxonomy curated by Platform Admin; no user can create canonical skills
Correlations (`correlates_with`) are bidirectional and computed statistically
Every course, challenge, job, and candidate skill tag MUST reference a canonical skill
Skill market signals update daily from aggregated data
Skill graph traversal depth bounded (max 5 hops)
Skill relationships must be acyclic for `prerequisite_of` (validated at write time)
Emerging skills require minimum 5 independent signals before taxonomy promotion
Credentials are append-only; revocation creates a new record with `revoked_at`
Every credential has a public verification URL (no PII exposed)
Credential evidence links are immutable once issued
Endorsement weights derive from endorser's verified reputation + relationship proximity
Appeal path exists for disputed credentials; SLA ≤7 days
Privacy-preserving proofs allow skill verification without revealing full profile
Credential issue requires underlying achievement verified by platform activity
Career outcome tracking requires explicit user opt-in
Aggregated career data requires k ≥5 for display
Individual career transitions visible only to the user
Progression benchmarks by role require ≥20 data points to publish
Salary progression tracked separately from base salary
Career graph updates do not retroactively alter historical benchmarks
Career path recommendations must disclose data sources and confidence intervals
Reputation score is derived, never manually set
Time-decay: signals older than 24 months count less
Reputation is private by default; recruiter visibility requires candidate consent or active application
Recordings encrypted at rest; retention ≤90 days unless extended
AI feedback is advisory; never a hiring decision input without human review
Interview questions are company-scoped; not visible to candidates before assessment
Assessment scores are append-only; changes are compensating entries
Live coding environment reuses the challenge sandbox
Comparison across candidates uses structured rubrics, never free-form scores
Salary reports require verification: self-reported (0.5) or verified via employment (1.0)
Aggregated salary data requires k ≥5 submissions per cell
Salary data displayed in minor units + ISO-4217 currency
Company-specific salary data shown only if company has ≥3 reports OR opted in
Users may withdraw their salary submission at any time
Salary intelligence updates quarterly; historical data versioned
Equity data (F-98) separately aggregated from salary
Recommendation factors must be disclosed ("why am I seeing this?")
Users can dismiss recommendations; dismissals train the model
Recommendations may not include promoted content without explicit "sponsored" label
Recommendation engine must be replaceable without breaking downstream features
Course outcome correlation requires ≥30 enrolled learners with measurable outcomes
Individual learner outcomes are never exposed without consent
Course quality scores derived from outcomes visible to instructors, not publicly ranked
Learning impact analytics do not create incentives to lower standards
Correlation is not causation — all outcome claims labelled as correlational
Peer mentorship sessions have a 30-day inactivity auto-close
Expert network calls may be paid; platform takes a transparent fee
Industry hubs must have ≥3 active contributors to display
Resume parsing never auto-applies changes without user review
Custom assessments must be approved by Platform Admin before deployment
Candidate comparison requires verified profiles only
DE&I analytics use aggregated data only; individual demographic data never stored
Post-hire analytics require employer consent and are aggregate-only
Badge marketplace prohibits paid badges; all badges earned
Mobile-first application must maintain feature parity with desktop
Accessibility is a release gate; WCAG 2.2 AA mandatory
API access requires enterprise tier; rate-limited per CON-006
Emerging skills require platform-wide adoption before taxonomy promotion
Job market analytics require k ≥10 data points per geographic cell
All new AI-powered features inherit AI safety rules §32
Introducer consent required for each introduction
Introducer can opt out of intro services
Target can block all intro requests
Introduction messages separate from cold outreach
No path suggestion for blocked users
Minimum reason category required on rejection
Feedback delivered within 7 days of decision
AI drafts require human review before sending
Candidate can request feedback if not provided (30-day window)
Negative feedback must include actionable element
Freshness score computed nightly, immutable per day
Decay curves per skill category, admin-configurable
Freshness visible to candidate always; recruiter-visible only with consent
Max 3 referral requests per 30 days per candidate
Referral tag visible to recruiter (priority signal)
Referral rewards follow org policy; XP default
No referral request from blocked user
Affiliation verified (email domain or institutional seat)
Alumni job postings must be from verified alumni
Alumni networks public or private (institution choice)
